g.text: Sampling above twice the highest signal frequency avoids ideal bandlimited aliasing

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: The continuous curve and sample points share exactly the same sine model. Reconstruction is ideal sinc interpolation with a complete sample sequence;
simply joining points is not exact. Practical systems use sampling margin above Nyquist and an analog anti-alias filter.
